# Competencies

What interviewers gather evidence about. Each one can say what it looks like at a level; leave a level out when the ladder already says enough.

## Craft {#craft}

Builds interfaces that work for everyone who uses them.

### junior

Reaches for the right HTML element, and checks the result in the browser.

### mid

Handles keyboard, focus and error states without being asked.

### senior

Sets the pattern other engineers copy.

## Judgment {#judgment}

Decides what matters, what to change, and what to leave alone.

### mid

Orders problems by who they hurt.

### senior

Names the cost of each option, and picks one for this context.

## Communication {#communication}

Explains the problem so a teammate could act on it.
